metodos-de-estudio-que-de-verdad-funcion.titulo: Rereading and highlighting barely work: the review that evaluated 10 study techniques with real evidence
metodos-de-estudio-que-de-verdad-funcion.resumen: A comprehensive review of scientific evidence on study techniques found that self-testing (retrieval practice) and spacing out study sessions over time are the techniques with the highest proven utility, while rereading and highlighting, the most popular methods, yield poor results.

cuanto-tiempo-toma-formar-un-habito.titulo: How long does it actually take to form a healthy habit? (It's not 21 days)
cuanto-tiempo-toma-formar-un-habito.resumen: A meta-analysis of 20 studies involving 2,601 people found that health habits take an average of 59 to 154 days to form, with enormous variability from person to person, far from the popular "21 days" myth.
